fab_recommendation: Order 5 bare boards or 2-5 assembled prototypes only after CAM preview. Do not release production quantity until electrical bring-up and thermal/current testing pass.
limitations: No KiCad ERC/DRC was run because KiCad is unavailable in this environment.
Gerbers were generated directly and must be visually inspected in the board house CAM viewer.
USB differential impedance was not field-solver verified.
5V LED current path must be validated at intended brightness/current.
